subject: Tidal Analytics trial kickoff — access matrix & sprint ownership
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@tidal-analytics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@tidal-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps from today — trial kickoff and access needs

Hi Elaine and Rajesh —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we agreed and the immediate asks so we can get your trial running this week: 

Summary of scope
- 14-day evaluation focused on real-time query routing and cost-per-token for your ingestion use case (index + rerank + query).
- Success criteria: median p99 latency <= 220ms on 512-token prompts, <15% quality regression vs. your current baseline on the sample prompt set (see attached).

Immediate access/ops asks (what we need from you)
1) Confirm the three people who should receive SSO invites for the trial console (we currently have Elaine and Rajesh; please add any others).
2) Provide the source IPs/subnet to allowlist for API calls (or confirm you'll use SSO-only flow).
3) Tell us whether you want an API key for server-to-server testing as a stopgap — we can issue a short-lived key.

Next steps and owners
- Mina (me): I'll provision the trial environment, create the success-metrics doc, and schedule a short tech orientation.
- Marissa: will create the API key and set up workspace roles after we receive allowed IPs.
- Ben: will send an eval checklist and runbook link and be point for latency/cost dashboards.

Attachments: redwood-poc-matrix.pdf (trial plan & roles), tidal-success-criteria.xlsx (we'll drop sample prompts in here).

Can you confirm the IPs and any additional teammates for SSO by EOD Wednesday PST? Once we have that, Marissa will issue an API key and we can kick off the first integration test.

Thanks —

Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-poc-matrix.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

Thanks Mina — the recap looks right. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- SSO users: please add Rajesh (rajesh@tidal-analytics.com), Elaine (elaine@tidal-analytics.com), and me (same) — we'll also add our infra lead (Vikram <vikram@tidal-analytics.com>) if needed.
- IP allowlist: our public egress sits behind a NAT; please allow 34.72.128.0/24 and 34.72.129.0/24 for the testing cluster.
- API key: yes, a short-lived server key would be helpful to validate backend integration before SSO flow is done. Please set TTL to 7 days.

On success criteria — can you add a small subjective quality check column (pass/fail) against our prompt set? We'll run parallel tests and share results.

Appreciate the quick turn. Once we have the key we'll kick off an automated smoke test and share the CI logs.

-Rajesh

Marissa / Ben — quick internal note with the exact asks from Tidal so we can move fast: 

Action list
- Marissa: create a temp API key with 7-day TTL for deal DEAL-2026-1098. Scope: generation+embeddings. Limit reqs/sec to 30 for the first 48 hours. Attach the key stub to the thread when done (api-key-stub.txt).
- Marissa: pre-create a workspace for tidal-analytics@redwood (name: tidal-trial-DEAL-1098) and assign roles: Rajesh (Admin), Elaine (Editor), Vikram (Viewer).
- Ben: add IP allowlist entries 34.72.128.0/24 and 34.72.129.0/24 and verify routing to the trial pool; then run a quick smoke load (10 reqs/s for 5m) and confirm p99 baseline.
- Mina: share success-criteria spreadsheet back to the customer with the subjective column added for their QC pass/fail.

Timing
- Aim to have API key and workspace ready by Wed 12/2 EOD PST. Smoke test Thurs morning and orientation call Thurs 11:00 PST if the customer is available.

Note: keep all internal credentials in the secure vault (Don’t post keys in external emails). I'll post the key stub in the thread once created.

Mina
